scope: Publish experimental sample scheduling and the production verified-circle integration repair, with failed epochs.

legal_sampling_defect.scope: A manufactured legal small-radius contact on the unchanged low shell proves finite-area continuum feasibility while the fixed Q10 cloud misses its wrench. This is a contact-regression diagnosis, not physical mesh/integration convergence or a throughput measurement.

validation.note: Scheduling/layout measurements use unchanged source 047d7de9 plus explicitly archived experimental native kernels. Production circle integration is a separate footprint integration change. No new-model speedup, large-batch four-scope acceptance or plateau is claimed.

storage_note: Runtime NPZ snapshots at least 1 MB and any artifact at least 20 MB stay in the project data directory with verified size/SHA256. Small raw sources, logs, conditions and fixtures are copied to Git. Failed and interrupted epochs are explicit.
